config.title: FUNDA — Real-time Price Ticker

intro.title: FUNDA — Real-time Price Ticker
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Real-time Price Ticker widget that receives streaming price updates over a WebSocket and displays a live feed of asset prices with colour-coded up/down flash indicators. To avoid triggering Angular's change detection on every incoming message, you will run the WebSocket handler outside Angular's zone using NgZone.runOutsideAngular(), buffer incoming prices, and re-enter the zone only when the component needs to visually update. The ticker uses OnPush with manual ChangeDetectorRef.detectChanges() for surgical rendering control.
intro.usecase: High-frequency data UIs appear in financial trading platforms, live sports scoreboards, IoT sensor dashboards, and multiplayer game leaderboards. NgZone.runOutsideAngular() demonstrates to interviewers that you understand Zone.js at a deep level.

objectives: Establish a WebSocket connection in a service and expose price updates as an Observable using fromEvent or a custom Subject
Open the connection and register the message handler inside NgZone.runOutsideAngular() to prevent zone-triggered CD on every message
Buffer incoming messages using throttleTime or auditTime and call NgZone.run() only when it is time to update the UI
Use ChangeDetectorRef.detach() on the ticker component and call detectChanges() manually after each buffered update
Apply a flash animation class (green/red) when a price moves up or down, removing it after 300ms with a timer outside the zone
Reconnect the WebSocket automatically on disconnect using retryWhen or retry with exponential back-off
Verify in Chrome DevTools Performance tab that disabling Zone.js triggers reduces the number of layout recalculations
